第二天早上九点整。

一辆深灰色的帕萨特稳稳停在金茂君悦酒店门口。苏晚棠坐在驾驶位，手指在方向盘上敲了两下，拿起手机发了条短信。

三十秒后，林川推开旋转门走出来。

深色POlO衫，浅灰休闲裤，手腕上那块百达翡丽星空陀飞轮被袖口半遮着，露出一截冷硬的表壳边缘。整个人没什么刻意的修饰，但气质干净、贵气。

苏晚棠从车里探出头。

“老板，上车。”

林川拉开副驾的门，坐进去。

车子汇入早高峰的车流。苏晚棠一手打着方向盘，一手从副驾储物格里抽出一份薄薄的资料递过来。

“今天去的地方，浦东张江那头，叫'东方科创港'。去年拿的地，今年刚建完一期，十六栋研发楼加两栋总部办公楼，定位中高端科技产业园。”

林川接过资料翻了一页。

“园区老板姓张，叫张立恒。四十出头，本地人，早年做过开发区管委会的招商科长，后来下海自己干园区运营。手里有两个盘子，东方科创港是他押注最重的一个。”

苏晚棠变了个道，语速没停。

“这人不蠢。园区硬件做得不错，但招商质量一直上不去。企业散、链条断，填了不少中小公司进去撑出租率，表面热闹，实际没有形成真正的产业协同。他自己也急，最近一直在找外部资本和资源方合作，想把园区往更高层级推。”

林川翻到第二页，上面是一张园区平面图。

“但是——”苏晚棠顿了一下，嘴角微微抿了一下，“有个麻烦。”

“说。”

“有个人比我们先搭上了这条线。上海本地一家叫'汇嘉资管'的机构，专做产业园区招商配套服务的。负责对接的人叫王志远，资历不浅，跟张立恒前后脚认识了七八年，平时饭桌上走得很近。”

她松了一下油门，车速慢下来。

“这人我以前在仲量联行接触过。典型的上海本地资源圈子里的人，嘴上功夫好，路子广，但说白了做的还是那套——帮园区拉企业进来，收个服务费，本质就是个高级中介。”

林川把资料合上，靠在椅背里。

“他今天也在？”

“今天也在。”苏晚棠看了后视镜一眼，“我昨天跟张立恒秘书确认行程的时候，对方顺嘴提了一句，说王总今天上午也过来。”

他脑子里的沙盘已经铺开了。一个本地做了七八年的园区老板，一个盘踞在上海资源圈里的老油条，这种局面最容易出现的情况就是——他们已经形成了某种默契和路径依赖，外来者不管带多少钱进来，第一反应都是“你懂上海吗”。

这不是钱的问题。

是认知权的问题。

谁能先说清楚这个园区真正的病在哪，谁就能拿到话语权。

十点二十分。

车子驶入浦东张江一带，拐进一条新修的产业大道。

东方科创港的大门很气派，白色的钢结构建筑群在阳光下泛着冷光，绿化带修剪得整整齐齐。但林川扫了一眼停车场，空位率超过四成。

车刚停稳，苏晚棠就看到展示中心门口站着三个人。

最前面的是个穿浅蓝衬衫的中年男人，身形微胖，面相和善，正在跟旁边一个穿深色西装的人笑着说话。

衬衫的是张立恒。

西装的那个四十岁上下，头发梳得一丝不苟，手腕上戴着块欧米茄，下巴微微扬着，笑容里带着种见惯场面的松弛。

王志远。

林川推开车门，和苏晚棠一前一后走过去。

张立恒第一眼看到的是苏晚棠。他笑着迎了两步，但脚步的方向明显偏向王志远那边。

“小苏，来了？一路辛苦。”

It was nine o'clock sharp the next morning.

A dark gray Passat parked steadily at the entrance of the Jinmao Grand Hyatt Hotel.Su Wantang sat in the driver's seat, tapped her fingers on the steering wheel twice, picked up her phone and sent a text message.

Thirty seconds later, Lin Chuan opened the revolving door and walked out.

Dark Polo shirt, light gray casual pants, the Patek Philippe Starry Sky Tourbillon on the wrist is half covered by the cuffs, revealing a cold and hard edge of the watch case.There is no deliberate decoration on the whole person, but the temperament is clean and noble.

Su Wantang stuck his head out of the car.

"Boss, get in the car."

Lin Chuan opened the passenger door and got in.

The car merged into the morning rush hour traffic.Su Wantang turned the steering wheel with one hand and pulled out a thin document from the passenger storage compartment and handed it over.

"The place we went to today, across the Zhangjiang River in Pudong, is called the 'Oriental Science and Technology Innovation Port'. The land acquired last year has just been completed for the first phase this year. It has 16 R&D buildings and two headquarters office buildings, positioning it as a mid-to-high-end science and technology industrial park."

Lin Chuan took the information and turned the page.

"The park owner's surname is Zhang Liheng. He is a local in his early 40s. He worked as the investment promotion section chief of the development zone management committee in his early years, and later went to work on his own to run the park. He has two projects in his hand, and the Oriental Science and Technology Innovation Port is the one he bets the most on."

Su Wantang changed his tune and kept speaking fast.

"This person is not stupid. The park's hardware is good, but the quality of investment has never been improved. Enterprises are scattered, the chain is broken, and many small and medium-sized companies have been filled in to support the rental rate. The surface is lively, but in fact no real industrial synergy has been formed. He is also anxious. Recently, he has been looking for external capital and resource parties to cooperate, and wants to push the park to a higher level."

Lin Chuan turned to the second page, which showed a floor plan of the park.

"But -" Su Wantang paused and pursed her lips slightly, "There is a problem."

"Say."

"There was someone who got on this line before us. A local organization in Shanghai called 'Huijia Asset Management' specializes in supporting services for investment in industrial parks. The person in charge of the connection is Wang Zhiyuan, who is quite senior. He has known Zhang Liheng for seven or eight years, and we usually get close to each other at the dinner table."

She eased off the accelerator and the car slowed down.

"I have met this person before at Jones Lang LaSalle. A typical person in Shanghai's local resource circle has good words and a wide range of channels, but to put it bluntly, what he does is still the same--helping the park attract companies to come in and charging a service fee. In essence, he is a high-level intermediary."

Lin Chuan closed the document and leaned back in his chair.

"Is he here today?"

"I'm here today." Su Wantang glanced at the rearview mirror, "When I was confirming the itinerary with Secretary Zhang Liheng yesterday, the other party casually mentioned that Mr. Wang would also be here this morning."

The sandbox in his mind has been laid out.A local park owner who has been working for seven or eight years, and a seasoned veteran who has been entrenched in Shanghai's resource circle. The most likely situation for this kind of situation is that they have formed a certain tacit understanding and path dependence. No matter how much money an outsider brings in, the first reaction is "Do you know Shanghai?"

It's not about money.

It's a matter of cognitive rights.

Whoever can first explain clearly what is really wrong with this park will have the right to speak.

Ten twenty.

The car drove into the Zhangjiang area of ​​Pudong and turned into a newly built industrial avenue.

The gate of Oriental Science and Technology Innovation Port is very grand. The white steel structure buildings glow coldly in the sun, and the green belt is neatly trimmed.But Lin Chuan glanced at the parking lot and found that the vacancy rate was over 40%.

As soon as the car stopped, Su Wantang saw three people standing at the door of the exhibition center.

The one at the front was a middle-aged man wearing a light blue shirt. He was slightly chubby and had a kind face. He was smiling and talking to a man in a dark suit next to him.

The one wearing the shirt is Zhang Liheng.

The man in the suit was about forty years old, his hair was combed meticulously, and he wore an Omega on his wrist. His chin was slightly raised, and his smile had a relaxed look that was familiar to others.

Wang Zhiyuan.

Lin Chuan opened the car door and walked over with Su Wantang one behind the other.

The first thing Zhang Liheng saw was Su Wantang.He smiled and took two steps toward Wang Zhiyuan, but the direction of his steps was obviously towards Wang Zhiyuan.

"Xiao Su, are you here? It's been a hard journey."
